# DreamLedger Commerce

Merchant: DreamLedger / HappyHomarid Master Sellers
Region: New Zealand first, global-ready
Currency: NZD
Payment: Stripe/card rails only
Cryptocurrency: not accepted

## Human entry points
- https://dreamledger.org/
- https://dreamledger.org/shop/
- https://dreamledger.org/mtg/

## Machine-readable commerce
- https://dreamledger.org/.well-known/commerce.json
- https://dreamledger.org/agentic/catalog.json
- https://dreamledger.org/sitemap.xml

## Product state
Candidate products are discoverable but not purchasable until explicitly approved. Never infer activation from catalog presence alone.

## Entitlements
A verified paid transaction can create a permanent or temporary entitlement. Protected goods are served only after server-side entitlement verification.

## Silo rules
SILO_MTG is the HappyHomarid Master Sellers Magic: The Gathering silo. Keep it separate from other commercial silos.

## Governance
Gauntlet Net is required for activation. Elohim is a review, contradiction-detection, evidence-gating and escalation layer, not a payment authority.
